chapterInfo.content:
6
Akagyinamdie ho kɔkɔbɔ
1 # Mmb 11.15; 17.18; 20.16 Me ba, sɛ wogyina wo yɔnko akyi,
sɛ wodi ɔhɔhoɔ agyinamu,
2sɛ wɔnam w’anomu asɛm so
akye wo a,
3yɛ yei mmom, me ba, na yi wo ho,
ɛfiri sɛ woatɔ wo yɔnko nsam;
kɔ kɔkoto, na srɛ wo yɔnko no.
4Mma nna nnkɔ w’ani so,
na mma w’anisuatɛtɛ nntɔ nko.
5Yi wo ho sɛ adowa firi ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ nsam,
sɛ anomaa firi fidisumfoɔ nsam.
Aniha ho kɔkɔbɔ
6 # Mmb 10.4; 20.4 Ɔkwadwofoɔ, kɔ tɛtea nkyɛn,
hwɛ n’akwan, na hunu nyansa.
7Ɔno na ɔnni otitire,
ɔpanin anaa sodifoɔ bie,
8nanso ɔsiesie n’aduane ahuhuberɛ,
na ɔboaboa n’adidideɛ ano twaberɛ mu.
9Wobɛda akɔsi da bɛn, ɔkwadwofoɔ?
Berɛ bɛn na wobɛsɔreɛ afiri wo nna mu?
10 # Mmb 24.33-34 Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra,
nsa a mɛpono mada kakra.
11Ɛnna wo hia bɛto wo sɛ ɔkwanmukafoɔ,
ne w’ahokyere sɛ ɛkyɛmkurafoɔ.
Nsekuro ho kɔkɔbɔ
12 # Mmb 10.31-32 Onipa huhuo ne ɔbarima busuyɛfoɔ,
ɔde ano kontonkyi nenam,
13 # Mmb 10.10 ɔbubu n’ani, ɔde ne nan kasa,
ɔde ne nsateaa kyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ,
14akontonkyisɛm wɔ n’akomam,
ɔpam ne tirim apammɔne daa,
takrawɔgyam na ɔhyɛ.
15Enti mpofirim na ne sɛeɛ bɛba,
wɔbɛbubu no amonom a wɔntumi nsa.
16Adeɛ nsia yi na AWURADE tane,
aane, na adeɛ nson na ɛyɛ ne kra akyiwadeɛ,
17ani a ɛtra ntɔn, atorɔ tɛkyerɛma,
ne nsa a ɛhwie mogya a ɛdi bem guo;
18akoma a ɛdwene mmusuo adwene,
nan a ɛyɛ herɛ tu mmirika kɔ bɔne mu;
19ɔdansekurumfoɔ a ɔhu atorosɛm,
ne deɛ ɔhyɛ anuanom ntam takrawɔgyam.
Awaresɛeɛ ho kɔkɔbɔ
20 # Mmb 1.8 Me ba, bu w’agya mmara nsɛm,
na nto wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ ntwene.
21 # Mmb 3.3 Fa kyekyere w’akoma ho daa nyinaa,
na fa bebare wo kɔn ho hyia.
22 # Dwom 119.172 Wonam a, ma no nkɔgya wo,
woda a, ɛnhwɛ wo so,
na wonyane a, ɛnyɛ wo sɛmɔdɛbɔ.
23Na mmara nsɛm no yɛ kanea, na nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛ hann,
na atenetene nkaanim yɛ nkwa kwan,
24 # Mmb 2.16 na ahwɛ wo so afiri ɔbaa bɔne ho,
afiri ɔbaa hɔhoɔ tɛkyerɛma dɔkɔdɔkɔ ho.
25Mma w’ani mmmere n’ahoɔfɛ w’akomam,
na mma no mmfa n’anisuatɛtɛ nnkye wo.
26Na ɛsiane ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ nti, wɔgyee ɔbarima paanoosini,
na obi yere deɛ, wɔgyee no ne nkwa a ne boɔ yɛ den no.
27Onipa de ogya bɛhyɛ ne kokom
a ne ntadeɛ renhyeɛ?
28Obi bɛfa nsramma so
a ne nan renhyeɛ?
29 # Mmb 5.10-14 Saa na deɛ ɔkɔ ne yɔnko yere nkyɛn teɛ,
na obiara a ɔkɔ ne yɔnko yere nkyɛn no renni bem.
30Sɛ ɛkɔm de owifoɔ na ɔwia adeɛ sɛ ɔredi amee a,
wɔmmu no animtia:
31Nanso sɛ wɔhu no a, ɔbɔ ho mprɛnson,
ɔde n’afideɛ nyinaa bɛma.
32 # 1 Ko 6.18 Deɛ ɔsɛe awadeɛ no nni ti,
deɛ ɔyɛ saa no de sɛe ne kra.
33Mmaa ne animguaseɛ na ɔbɛnya,
na n’ahohora no, wɔmpepa.
34Na ninkunu twetwe ɔbarima abufuhyeɛ,
na aweretɔ da no ɔremfa nkyɛ;
35ɔremmu mpata biara,
na woma akyɛdeɛ dɔɔso mpo a, ɔrempene.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me ba, sɛ wogyina wo yɔnko akyi,
sɛ wodi ɔhɔhoɔ agyinamu,
sɛ wɔnam w’anomu asɛm so
akye wo a,
yɛ yei mmom, me ba, na yi wo ho,
ɛfiri sɛ woatɔ wo yɔnko nsam;
kɔ kɔkoto, na srɛ wo yɔnko no.
Mma nna nnkɔ w’ani so,
na mma w’anisuatɛtɛ nntɔ nko.
Yi wo ho sɛ adowa firi ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ nsam,
sɛ anomaa firi fidisumfoɔ nsam.

Ɔkwadwofoɔ, kɔ tɛtea nkyɛn,
hwɛ n’akwan, na hunu nyansa.
Ɔno na ɔnni otitire,
ɔpanin anaa sodifoɔ bie,
nanso ɔsiesie n’aduane ahuhuberɛ,
na ɔboaboa n’adidideɛ ano twaberɛ mu.
Wobɛda akɔsi da bɛn, ɔkwadwofoɔ?
Berɛ bɛn na wobɛsɔreɛ afiri wo nna mu?
Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra,
nsa a mɛpono mada kakra.
Ɛnna wo hia bɛto wo sɛ ɔkwanmukafoɔ,
ne w’ahokyere sɛ ɛkyɛmkurafoɔ.

Onipa huhuo ne ɔbarima busuyɛfoɔ,
ɔde ano kontonkyi nenam,
ɔbubu n’ani, ɔde ne nan kasa,
ɔde ne nsateaa kyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ,
akontonkyisɛm wɔ n’akomam,
ɔpam ne tirim apammɔne daa,
takrawɔgyam na ɔhyɛ.
Enti mpofirim na ne sɛeɛ bɛba,
wɔbɛbubu no amonom a wɔntumi nsa.
Adeɛ nsia yi na AWURADE tane,
aane, na adeɛ nson na ɛyɛ ne kra akyiwadeɛ,
ani a ɛtra ntɔn, atorɔ tɛkyerɛma,
ne nsa a ɛhwie mogya a ɛdi bem guo;
akoma a ɛdwene mmusuo adwene,
nan a ɛyɛ herɛ tu mmirika kɔ bɔne mu;
ɔdansekurumfoɔ a ɔhu atorosɛm,
ne deɛ ɔhyɛ anuanom ntam takrawɔgyam.

Me ba, bu w’agya mmara nsɛm,
na nto wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ ntwene.
Fa kyekyere w’akoma ho daa nyinaa,
na fa bebare wo kɔn ho hyia.
Wonam a, ma no nkɔgya wo,
woda a, ɛnhwɛ wo so,
na wonyane a, ɛnyɛ wo sɛmɔdɛbɔ.
Na mmara nsɛm no yɛ kanea, na nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛ hann,
na atenetene nkaanim yɛ nkwa kwan,
na ahwɛ wo so afiri ɔbaa bɔne ho,
afiri ɔbaa hɔhoɔ tɛkyerɛma dɔkɔdɔkɔ ho.
Mma w’ani mmmere n’ahoɔfɛ w’akomam,
na mma no mmfa n’anisuatɛtɛ nnkye wo.
Na ɛsiane ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ nti, wɔgyee ɔbarima paanoosini,
na obi yere deɛ, wɔgyee no ne nkwa a ne boɔ yɛ den no.
Onipa de ogya bɛhyɛ ne kokom
a ne ntadeɛ renhyeɛ?
Obi bɛfa nsramma so
a ne nan renhyeɛ?
Saa na deɛ ɔkɔ ne yɔnko yere nkyɛn teɛ,
na obiara a ɔkɔ ne yɔnko yere nkyɛn no renni bem.
Sɛ ɛkɔm de owifoɔ na ɔwia adeɛ sɛ ɔredi amee a,
wɔmmu no animtia:
Nanso sɛ wɔhu no a, ɔbɔ ho mprɛnson,
ɔde n’afideɛ nyinaa bɛma.
Deɛ ɔsɛe awadeɛ no nni ti,
deɛ ɔyɛ saa no de sɛe ne kra.
Mmaa ne animguaseɛ na ɔbɛnya,
na n’ahohora no, wɔmpepa.
Na ninkunu twetwe ɔbarima abufuhyeɛ,
na aweretɔ da no ɔremfa nkyɛ;
ɔremmu mpata biara,
na woma akyɛdeɛ dɔɔso mpo a, ɔrempene.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
